1.consolidated_definition: Cantidad de dinero, o cosa equivalente, que alguien debe a una persona o entidad, y que el acreedor tiene derecho de exigir y cobrar.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Amount of money or equivalent value that one person owes to another individual or entity, and for which the creditor has a right to demand and collect.
